==Description== <!--T:3-->

<!--T:4-->
The '''Std DevHandbook''' command opens the FreeCAD Developers Handbook in the system's default Internet browser. The command requires a working Internet connection.

<!--T:5-->
Currently the command points to [https://freecad.github.io/DevelopersHandbook https://freecad.github.io/DevelopersHandbook].

==Usage== <!--T:6-->

<!--T:7-->
# Select the {{MenuCommand|Help → [[Image:Std_DevHandbook.svg|16px]] Developers Handbook}} option from the menu.
